name: Limit Utilisation Journal Search Criteria 2
definition: Defines the criteria used to search for a limit.

LimitType.name: Limit Type
LimitType.definition: Type of limit applied by the system at the present time.

JournalActivityDate.name: Journal Activity Date
JournalActivityDate.definition: Date upon which journal activity takes place.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

LimitCurrency.name: Limit Currency
LimitCurrency.definition: Currency unit used to specify the limit amount.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Owner of the account which is being queried.

BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification.name: Bilateral Limit Counterparty Identification
BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification.definition: Identification of the system member for which the limit is established.
